from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class JudgmentDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents a single judgment document extracted from the collection."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title of the judgment document")
    cause_of_action_or_charge: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause of action or criminal charge identified in the document")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The general category of the case (e.g., 'Criminal', 'Civil', 'Administrative')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[JudgmentDocument]
